Apacer Panther GOLD AS340 120GB 2.5" SATA III SSD – Boost Your PC Speed!

Upgrade your PC or laptop performance with the Apacer Panther AS340 120GB SSD. Designed for budget-conscious users, this 2.5-inch SATA III SSD offers high-speed data transfer, durable 3D NAND flash memory, and shock resistance for dependable everyday computing.

  • Storage Capacity: 120GB – Ideal for boot drives and essential applications
  • Interface: SATA III (6Gbps) – Compatible with most desktops and laptops
  • Read Speed: Up to 550MB/s – Quick boot times and smooth multitasking
  • Write Speed: Up to 500MB/s – Fast file transfers and improved performance
  • Form Factor: 2.5-inch – Standard size for easy upgrades
  • Flash Type: 3D TLC NAND – Better endurance and performance
  • MTBF: 1.5 million hours – Long-lasting and reliable
  • Shock Resistance: 1500G/0.5ms – Protection against accidental drops
